title: probe-ext flow
description: The probe-ext extension's first flow. Replace this procedure with the real one, or delete the flows directory and the flows entry in mpd-ext.json.
whenToUse: Use when a task needs the repeatable procedure this flow describes.

steps.title: Collect the input
steps.detail: Describe what the first step reads and where it comes from.
steps.output: The input the procedure needs, in the form the next step expects.

steps.title: Apply the extension's skill
steps.detail: Follow the probe-ext-skill skill: do the work it describes, naming the contract each result can change.
steps.output: The result of the procedure, with the file behind every claim.

steps.title: Report the outcome
steps.detail: State what was done, what was verified and what was NOT verified. If this extension still ships its stdio MCP server, its describe_extension tool reports the id, root and contributed kinds exactly as the running host sees them.
steps.output: A short report with the evidence behind each claim.
